several years ago in China, in Southeast Asia, etc., they have already come online. So if you
look at it from that macro perspective; really speaking, today, there should be absolutely no

general disruptions which take place with geopolitical material movement. This is not linked to
a commodity super cycle as you would otherwise define. And this gives companies that have
large-scale efficient manufacturing and good wallet share, a much better control than one would
anticipate as a commodity.
